title: Chizkiyah, Father of Ikesh
author: Aharon Hyman
attribution: Model-assisted translation, editorially reviewed; publication authorized by Joshua Waxman.

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Bekhorot 38a, testifying before Rabban Gamliel at Yavneh in the name of Rabban Gamliel the Elder. So also in the Sifra, Shemini 129; the Yalkut there, remez 539, reads Chizkiyah of Ikesh. Hyman suggests that possibly it is a place-name.

notes.text: Bekhorot 38a in the William Davidson digital edition has Chizkiyah avi Ikesh. Hyman also reports ish Ikesh and tentatively interprets Ikesh as a place; the father/place distinction is not resolved by a name merge.
Bekhorot 38a and the consulted Sifra passage both have avi Ikesh. The selected Sifra passage does not name the Elder. The Yalkut wording and the place-name conjecture remain Hyman’s reports.
